name: San Andrés
summary: San Andrés is a Caribbean island belonging to Colombia, closer to Nicaragua, with English-speaking Raizal culture. Snorkel the 'sea of seven colours', boat to Johnny Cay and the Acuario, ride a golf cart around the island, and take a hop to quieter Providencia.
seasonNote: January to April is driest; hurricane risk September to November.
arrival: Flights from Bogotá, Medellín and Cartagena; a tourist card is paid on arrival.
gettingAround: Golf carts, scooters and buses around the island.
cashTip: Cards work in hotels; carry pesos for golf carts, boat trips and beach food. A tourist entry card is charged on arrival.
foodTip: Rondón stew, crab and fried fish with coconut rice.
